data.title: Jobcenter invitation for 22 April 2026
data.summary: Jobcenter Musterlingen invites Lea Muster to a meeting on 22 April 2026 at 08:15 in room 1.18 with Ms Petzold to discuss her current job situation. Missing it without good reason cuts her Bürgergeld.
data.explanation: This is a formal summons (Meldeaufforderung) from the Jobcenter. You must attend the appointment on 22 April 2026 at 08:15 in room 1.18 and bring your CV. If you cannot go for an important reason, contact the Jobcenter before the date and explain why. If you miss it without a good reason, your Bürgergeld is reduced by 10 percent of the standard rate for one month. If you are unsure, a counselling service can help.
